description: Redesign core user-facing pages to ultra-premium quality: Home, Login, Register, Dashboard, Devices, DeviceDetail, Community, Marketplace, Profile. Apply design system from FEAT-002, add sophisticated animations, perfect mobile responsiveness, glassmorphism effects, gradient accents, micro-interactions. Each page must feel like a million-dollar product (Stripe/Linear/Apple quality).
steps: 1. Home.jsx: enhance hero section with animated gradient background (mesh gradient with slow movement), add floating particle effects using Framer Motion, upgrade stats section with CountUp animation for numbers, make circular action cards more premium with glass effect and hover lift, add scroll-triggered fade-in animations for each section, optimize mobile layout with proper spacing and touch targets, add subtle parallax effect to decorative elements

2. Login.jsx & Register.jsx: upgrade left branding panel with animated gradient mesh background, add floating testimonial cards with glassmorphism, enhance form inputs with focus glow effects, add smooth page transition animations, improve mobile layout with full-screen form and slide-in animation, add password strength indicator for Register, add social proof badges

3. Dashboard.jsx: redesign stats cards with glass effect and animated counters, add sparkline charts to stats using recharts, enhance device list with hover expand effect showing quick actions, add empty state illustration with animation, implement skeleton loaders for loading states, add quick action cards with gradient backgrounds and hover lift, optimize mobile grid layout

4. Devices.jsx: redesign as card grid with glassmorphism, add sophisticated filtering sidebar with animated toggles, implement smooth list/grid view toggle with Framer Motion layout animations, add health score visualization with animated circular progress, enhance search with debounce and loading state, add bulk actions bar that slides in when items selected, optimize mobile with bottom sheet filters

5. DeviceDetail.jsx: create premium detail layout with large image gallery (with Framer Motion carousel), add tabbed interface (Overview, Health History, Predictions, Actions) with smooth transitions, visualize health timeline with animated line chart, add AI insights card with typing animation effect, implement share modal with social links, add related items carousel, optimize mobile with sticky action bar

6. Community.jsx: redesign feed with glass cards and smooth infinite scroll, add sophisticated post composer with rich text preview, implement live reaction animations (like button with heart burst), add trending topics sidebar with animated badges, enhance image previews with lightbox modal, add filter chips with smooth transitions, optimize mobile with floating action button for new post

7. Marketplace.jsx: redesign listing grid with premium image cards and hover zoom effect, add advanced filter panel with glassmorphism and animated checkboxes, implement map view toggle with Leaflet integration preview, add save/favorite animation with heart fill effect, enhance listing detail modal with image gallery and smooth transitions, add verified seller badges with animated checkmarks, optimize mobile with bottom sheet filters and swipeable cards

8. Profile.jsx: create premium profile layout with cover image and glass profile card overlay, add tabbed sections (Activity, Impact, Devices, Settings) with smooth transitions, visualize impact stats with animated donut charts, add achievement badges with unlock animations, implement edit mode with inline editing and auto-save indicator, add QR code card for profile sharing, optimize mobile with collapsible sections

9. For ALL pages: add Framer Motion page transition wrapper (fade + slide), ensure every interactive element has hover/active states, add loading skeletons for async data, implement error states with illustrations, ensure WCAG AA accessibility (focus states, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation), test responsiveness at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1920px breakpoints
acceptance_criteria: Home page has animated gradient hero, floating particles, scroll-triggered animations, perfect mobile layout
Login/Register have glassmorphism branding panels, smooth animations, mobile-optimized forms
Dashboard has glass stat cards, animated counters, skeleton loaders, quick actions with gradients
Devices page has card/grid view toggle, animated filters, health visualizations, mobile bottom sheet
DeviceDetail has image gallery, tabbed interface, health charts, AI insights, mobile sticky bar
Community has glass feed cards, live reactions, trending sidebar, lightbox, mobile FAB
Marketplace has premium listing grid, advanced filters, map toggle, favorite animations, mobile swipe cards
Profile has cover image + glass card, tabbed sections, impact charts, achievement animations, QR code
All pages have page transitions, loading states, error states, accessibility, responsive design
verification: Run 'npm run dev' and navigate through all 9 pages
Test Home: verify hero animations, particle effects, stat counters animate on scroll, mobile responsive
Test Login/Register: verify gradient panel animates, form has focus glow, mobile layout is full-screen
Test Dashboard: verify glass cards, counters animate, device list hover works, skeleton loaders appear during loading
Test Devices: verify grid/list toggle animates smoothly, filters work, health circles animate, mobile filters slide up from bottom
Test DeviceDetail: verify image carousel works, tabs switch smoothly, charts render, AI card has typing effect
Test Community: verify feed cards have glass effect, reactions animate, trending sidebar updates, lightbox opens
Test Marketplace: verify listing grid has zoom hover, filters panel has glass effect, favorite heart animates
Test Profile: verify cover image + glass card overlay, tabs switch smoothly, charts animate, badges have unlock effect
Open browser dev tools responsive mode: test each page at 320px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1024px (desktop), 1920px (large) - verify layouts adapt perfectly with no horizontal scroll or broken layouts
Check browser console: verify zero errors, warnings about accessibility should be minimal
